ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is trapezoid CDFG, the upper base CD is labeled as 46, the lower base GF is the length to be found; points H and E are respectively on the two legs, segment HE is parallel to the two bases, and HE is labeled as 38. The problem states that HE is the midline of the trapezoid. Reasoning: The length of the midline of a trapezoid is equal to the average of the lengths of the two bases, so HE = (CD + GF) / 2. Substitute the values: 38 = (46 + GF) / 2. Multiplying both sides by 2 gives 76 = 46 + GF, therefore GF = 76 - 46 = 30.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as trapezoid CDFG: the top base CD is labeled 46, the interior median segment HE is labeled 38, and the bottom base GF is the requested unknown. From the text, use that HE is the median of the trapezoid. Apply the trapezoid median formula: median length equals the average of the two bases, so HE = (CD + GF)/2. Substitute 38 = (46 + GF)/2, solve 76 = 46 + GF, giving GF = 30.
